content.text: {"window_id":"w0025","observed_failures":[{"filename":"074.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":"702.00","issue":"Incorrect total extracted; likely picked wrong numeric line from THAI DELICIOUS receipt where correct total is 92.80 (visible as 'Total : 92.80' and 'Grand Total : 92.80')."},{"filename":"077.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":"23.26","issue":"Picked GST-inclusive subtotal line 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' instead of final 'TOTAL: 23.25' after rounding adjustment."},{"filename":"078.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":"","issue":"Extraction returned empty string instead of null when extraction failed; also failed to find a value (Popular Book receipt has 'Total RM 21.00')."},{"filename":"034.jpg","field":"date","predicted":"2018-08-09","issue":"Date wrong; receipt (Perniagaan Zheng Hui) shows '09/03/2018' which should parse as 2018-03-09 under DD/MM/YYYY, but was interpreted as MM/DD or month/day swapped."}],"root_causes":[{"id":"rc1","description":"Two-line keyword→amount fallback is too permissive: when the keyword line has a corrupt/garbled number, the code falls through to subsequent lines (e.g., 'Visa RM ...') and picks a payment amount instead of the real total.","evidence":"Trace in exchange e0046/e0047 shows candidate 'Total RM = B81?' with no valid decimal number, then fallback consumed next 'Visa RM =688.17' line. Fix drafted in current candidate restricts fallback to keyword lines with no digits."},{"id":"rc2","description":"Priority tier ordering does not consistently prefer the final rounded 'TOTAL:' line over earlier 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' line when both match the generic TOTAL tier. The algorithm takes last candidate in document order, but on receipts where the final 'TOTAL:' line is on a separate visual line from the number, it may miss it and fall back to the inclusive-GST line.","evidence":"077.jpg predicted 23.26 (inclusive-of-GST line) rather than 23.25 (final rounded TOTAL)."},{"id":"rc3","description":"Null handling writes empty string instead of Python None when extraction fails, violating task spec that failures must be null (empty cell).","evidence":"078.jpg total_amount predicted as '' (empty string) rather than null."},{"id":"rc4","description":"Date parser does not reliably prefer DD/MM/YYYY over MM/DD/YYYY for Malaysian receipts, leading to swapped month/day when both interpretations are valid calendar dates.","evidence":"034.jpg date predicted 2018-08-09 instead of 2018-03-09 for a '09/03/2018' receipt."},{"id":"rc5","description":"Grand Total / final TOTAL detection does not restrict search to the summary/footer region of the receipt, so earlier item-line 'Total' entries (e.g., per-item totals in itemized tables) can be matched.","evidence":"074.jpg predicted 702.00; receipt has itemized 'Amount' column with values whose last two digits may OCR as 702, while true Grand Total is 92.80 at bottom."}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Total-extraction fallback rule (two-line split) is specified but lacks a guard requiring the keyword line to contain no digits before falling through. Current skill text says 'when the matched keyword line has no number, take the LAST number from the next non-empty line' — this is ambiguous and allowed matching corrupt-digit lines. Needs tightening to: 'only fall through to the next line when the keyword line contains zero digit characters, and skip fallback lines that themselves contain payment keywords (VISA, MASTERCARD, CASH, DEBIT, CARD, CHANGE).'"},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Priority tier for 'final rounded TOTAL' is not distinguished from 'Total (Inclusive of GST)'. The skill should instruct: when multiple TOTAL-tier matches exist, prefer the LAST occurrence that is NOT labeled 'Inclusive of GST', 'Incl GST', 'Including GST', 'Excl GST', 'Excluding GST', 'Sales', 'TakeOut Total', 'Rounded', 'Before Rounding' unless it is the only match; otherwise prefer lines labeled 'Total Rounded', 'TOTAL:', 'Grand Total', 'Net Total', 'Total After Rounding', 'Total RM' (standalone)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Null output rule is stated but the batch pipeline example does not demonstrate guaranteeing None (not empty string) in the final Excel. Needs explicit guidance: before writing, replace NaN/''/'None' with Python None, and verify via pandas isna check."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction does not encode the regional convention. For receipts likely in Malaysian/UK/EU format (presence of 'RM', 'GST', 'SST', or Malaysian addresses), DD/MM/YYYY must be tried BEFORE MM/DD/YYYY. Current DATE_PATTERNS ordering tries 'DD/MM/YYYY' before 'DD/MM/YY' but doesn't disambiguate against ambiguous MM/DD cases, and the ISO-first pattern can grab a non-date numeric sequence."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No guidance to restrict total-amount keyword search to the receipt's summary/footer region (below the last item-line divider or below a 'Subtotal'/'Total Items'/'Item Count' marker). This causes false positives on itemized tables with 'Total' column headers or per-item amount columns."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Number regex accepts bare integers (e.g., '20') which can match item quantities or page numbers. For total extraction, should strongly prefer numbers with explicit two-decimal places; integers should only be accepted if no decimal number exists on the keyword line or its RM-prefixed value is unambiguous."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"No explicit instruction that for pandas->Excel export, string columns containing None must be written such that the cell is empty (not 'None', not NaN-as-text). Suggest adding guidance: use df.astype(object).where(df.notna(), None) prior to to_excel, or set na_rep=''."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Strengthen total-extraction rules: (1) explicitly state that two-line fallback is permitted ONLY when the keyword line contains no digit characters; (2) add payment-keyword exclusions to fallback target lines (VISA, MASTERCARD, DEBIT, CARD, CASH, CHANGE, PAYMENT, TENDERED); (3) prefer last matching candidate within the summary region but demote candidates whose line contains 'Inclusive of GST', 'Incl GST', 'Excluding GST', 'Excl GST', 'Sales', 'TakeOut', 'Before Rounding'; (4) when multiple TOTAL-tier candidates exist, prefer those labeled 'Total Rounded', 'Total After Rounding', 'Net Total', 'Grand Total', or final bare 'TOTAL:'; (5) restrict primary search to lines appearing after the first occurrence of a summary marker (Subtotal, Sub-Total, Item Count, Total Qty, GST, SST, Tax Summary) when such a marker exists."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a dedicated 'Final Total Selection Algorithm' pseudocode block that: locates summary_start index, iterates priority tiers, applies exclusion keywords, applies demotion keywords, and only then applies the strict two-line fallback."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand date-extraction guidance: for receipts with currency 'RM' or Malaysian/Singaporean/UK indicators, try DD/MM/YYYY and DD-MM-YYYY FIRST; only fall back to MM/DD/YYYY when the day value exceeds 12 under DD/MM interpretation. Add a disambiguation rule: if both interpretations yield valid dates and no regional hint is present, prefer DD/MM for receipts (common for the dataset) and document this bias explicitly."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Tighten number regex guidance: for total_amount, prefer the rightmost token matching r'(?<![\\w.])\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2}(?![\\w\\d])' on the keyword line; accept bare integers only when no decimal match exists on that line AND the integer is immediately preceded by 'RM', '$', or ':' with whitespace."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Mandate null-not-empty output: explicitly instruct that failed extractions set the field to Python None; show a correct example that uses df.where(df.notna(), None) and writes with na_rep=''; add a self-check item: 'Verify no cell contains the literal string None or empty-string sentinel.'"},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'Common Receipt Pitfalls' subsection enumerating observed failure patterns: (a) 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' vs final 'TOTAL:' after rounding, (b) 'Visa RM ...' / 'Mastercard' payment lines following a keyword line, (c) itemized tables containing per-row 'Total' columns, (d) 'TakeOut Total' and 'Total Rounded' both present, (e) 'Total Gross' vs 'Total' on fuel receipts (treat Total RM as the authoritative total, ignore 'Total Gross' when both appear)."},{"skill":"xlsx","change":"Add explicit instruction for writing nullable string columns to Excel so empty cells are written (not 'None'/'nan'): recommend converting with .astype(object).where(notna, None) and using na_rep='' in to_excel; include a verification snippet reading back with pandas and asserting pd.isna on failed rows."},{"skill":"openai-vision","change":"No change required for this task (OCR path used Tesseract); optionally add a cross-reference note in image-ocr pointing to openai-vision as a fallback for severely degraded scans where Tesseract yields empty/garbled text, with a documented contract that outputs still conform to the null-or-two-decimal-string rule."}],"confidence":{"observed_failures":"high","root_causes":"medium-high","skill_defects":"medium-high","repair_recommendations":"medium","notes":"Diagnosis derived from field_feedback (4 incorrect fields: 034 date, 074/077/078 amount) and traced to Skill rules via exchange windows showing the fallback bug. Oracle values were not read; recommended demotion/promotion keyword lists are general and should generalize beyond this sample."}}
